cohort: 423 mothers with infants less than 6 months old in Amhara region, Ethiopia
finding: The prevalence of timely initiation of breastfeeding was 65%, with infant sex, breastfeeding counseling, birth place, mode of delivery, and religious father support being significant predictors.
mod_finding: Normal labor was associated with higher odds of timely initiation of breastfeeding compared to other modes of delivery.
